nativeBaseline.reference: named navigation landmark containing authored native destination links

library: preserve native link behavior, DOM keyboard order, current-page semantics, visible focus, and logical directionality
provide grouped navigation structure without introducing tree-navigation or router behavior
consumer: author meaningful destinations and a navigation landmark name when required by page context
own URLs, route matching, current destination, route guards, authentication, permissions, and navigation policy

notes: SideNav intentionally relies on native navigation-landmark and link semantics rather than an APG tree or menu interaction model.
Current-page semantics and landmark naming are machine-testable contract requirements; no component-specific spoken-announcement behavior is claimed.
